items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: Well, I can't pretty much remember the tune now, but such as Grace and Brody and Grace and Beauty

ctx.x: Well, now you mentioned some tunes where they have special clarinet parts. What would some of the tunes be like that?

Well, I can't pretty much remember the tune now, but such as Grace and Brody and Grace and Beauty and, uh, and, uh, Black and White, and, uh, well, it's different numbers. So I can't remember this part of his list now. You see, well, uh, you see it says it's Panama. Well, a Panama was a number that would play pretty much a good tempo number for a phone number. But, uh, uh, uh, in that, for a man to take a solo, it had to be to dry your lips.
